newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent lower to 0.100 cent higher and for feeder cattle from 0.200 cent lower to 0.100 cent higher, analysts said.

Some analysts look for carryover pressure from weak technicals and selling prompted by expectations the cash markets have put in a near term top. Cash markets are seen slipping into the summer as beef demand wanes seasonally and increased fed cattle supplies become available, they said.
But some analysts still look for support after active feedlot movement at most major feedlot areas, they added.
Most analysts look for carryover pressure in feeder futures after funds went from long to short during Thursday's break and some further sell-stop selling is likely.
Technically, the market broke through support levels.
However, others look for renewed support following the advance in the latest index which put futures at a discount and calls for lower corn futures.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.27 at $78.03 per cwt, a new high for the move and highest level since August, 18, 1994.
